summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary (read-only, no changes made)  I traced the full watchlist chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts` → auth session store in `db/auth.ts`.  What I found **looks correctly wired** in the current code: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read and write goes through `api.get`/`api.post`/`api.delete` against `/watchlist*`. - `api.ts` sends `credentials: "include"` on every request, so the session cookie should travel with each call. - `watchlists.user_id`
